# Cornerstone AI: we build your business its operating system

Every business has an operating system: the way work actually moves through it. How a client gets onboarded, how projects get tracked, how invoices go out, how nothing slips. Most businesses never designed theirs. It grew by accident, and the founder became it.

We build the real one. A system built around how your business already works, run by AI, sitting across the tools you already use, and owned outright by you. It reads and writes in your email, your client list, your invoicing and your project board, so your team keeps working where they work and sees one shared picture instead of five half-updated tools.

One rule is built in from day one: routine work runs on its own, but anything leaving the business, money or a message to a client, waits for a human yes.

Delivered as an eight-week build. Week one maps how work actually moves. Weeks two to seven build it live, one piece at a time, with weekly training. Week eight is handover: keys, documentation, full ownership. $5,500 USD split into two payments, or $4,950 paid in full.

Everything is built inside your own accounts, so your data never moves into ours and the system keeps running whether or not we are involved. There is no platform fee and no licence. An optional monthly retainer exists for ongoing work; it is never required.

Built for service businesses with real clients and a small team, where everything still routes through the founder and that is capping growth.

Based in South Africa. Serving businesses globally.
